en.about.title: About Moistello
en.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
en.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
en.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
en.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
en.faq.title: FAQ
en.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
en.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
en.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
en.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
en.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
en.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
en.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
en.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
en.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
en.howItWorks.title: How It Works
en.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
en.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
en.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
en.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
en.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
en.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
en.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
en.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
en.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ab.about.title: About Moistello
ab.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ab.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ab.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ab.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ab.faq.title: FAQ
ab.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ab.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ab.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ab.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ab.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ab.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ab.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ab.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ab.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ab.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ab.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ab.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ab.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ab.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ab.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ab.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ab.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ab.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ab.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ab.support.commitmentPeopleDesc: No chatbots. Every ticket is handled by a human.

ak.about.title: About Moistello
ak.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ak.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ak.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ak.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ak.faq.title: FAQ
ak.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ak.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ak.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ak.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ak.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ak.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ak.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ak.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ak.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ak.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ak.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ak.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ak.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ak.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ak.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ak.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ak.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ak.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ak.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

an.about.title: About Moistello
an.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
an.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
an.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
an.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
an.faq.title: FAQ
an.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
an.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
an.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
an.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
an.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
an.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
an.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
an.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
an.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
an.howItWorks.title: How It Works
an.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
an.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
an.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
an.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
an.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
an.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
an.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
an.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
an.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ar.about.title: حول مويستيلو
ar.about.missionDesc: لا يزال 1.3 مليار بالغ غير مشمولين بالخدمات المصرفية عالميًا. في مجتمعات إفريقيا وأمريكا اللاتينية وجنوب آسيا وجنوب شرق آسيا، يعتمد الناس على دوائر الادخار غير الرسمية — الإسوسو، التونتين، صناديق شيت، التانداس — للوصول إلى رأس المال وبناء المرونة المالية. تجمع مويستيلو هذا النموذج العريق في عقود ذكية عبر سوروبان على شبكة ستيلار، مما يمنح الشفافية والأمان والسمعة المالية الموثوقة لكل مشارك.
ar.about.whyStellarDesc: رسوم معاملات ستيلار التي تقل عن سنت واحد والتسوية في غضون 3-5 ثوانٍ تجعل دورات المساهمة عملية للغاية. توفر منصة العقود الذكية سوروبان إمكانية البرمجة لقواعد دفع معقدة وآليات المزادات وتتبع السمعة — وكل ذلك مع الحفاظ على تكاليف الغاز شبه منعدمة.
ar.about.openSourceDesc: عقودنا الذكية وواجهة برمجة التطبيقات وواجهة المستخدم كلها مفتوحة المصدر بموجب ترخيص أباتشي 2.0. شارك وساهم عبر غيت هاب.
ar.about.contactDesc: انضم إلى مجتمعنا على ديسكورد أو افتح تذكرة على مستودعنا في غيت هاب.
ar.faq.title: الأسئلة الشائعة
ar.faq.q1: ما هي دائرة الادخار (جمعية ادخار وائتمان دورية)؟
ar.faq.a1: جمعية الادخار والائتمان الدورية هي مجموعة من الأفراد يساهمون بمبلغ ثابت بانتظام. في كل دورة، يتلقى أحد الأعضاء كامل المبلغ المجمع. تُعرف عالميًا بالجمعية، الإسوسو، التونتين، التاندا وصناديق شيت.
ar.faq.a2: تعتمد الدوائر التقليدية على الثقة المتبادلة. يستخدم مويستيلو مفاتيح المرور البيومترية وعقود سوروبان الذكية لتطبيق القواعد بكل شفافية. دون الحاجة إلى بريد إلكتروني أو كلمة مرور أو حساب بنكي. سجل الدخول ببصمة إصبعك أو وجهك وابدأ الادخار.
ar.faq.a3: لا. لا تحتاج حتى إلى محفظة ستيلار مسبقة. يقوم مويستيلو بإنشاء واحدة لك تلقائيًا باستخدام مفتاح المرور الخاص بك (بصمة الوجه أو الإصبع). ما عليك سوى تسجيل الدخول والبدء في الادخار. متاح لكل من يملك هاتفًا ذكيًا.
ar.faq.a4: عملة USDC (على شبكة ستيلار). المزيد من العملات المستقرة قادمة في المستقبل.
ar.faq.q5: ماذا لو تخلف أحد عن السداد؟
ar.faq.a5: تخضع المدفوعات المتأخرة لغرامة قابلة للتهيئة. بعد الوصول للحد الأقصى من التنبيهات، يتم استبعاد العضو من الدائرة.
ar.faq.a6: سجل سمعتك المالية على البلوكتشين (من 0 إلى 1000) المبني على التزامك المستمر، ومشاركاتك المكتملة، وحجم مساهماتك. تتيح النقاط العالية الوصول إلى دوائر أكبر وفرص أفضل.
ar.faq.a7: مجانية تمامًا لإنشاء الدوائر والانضمام إليها. رسوم شبكة ستيلار أقل من 0.001 دولار لكل معاملة. لا توجد أي رسوم للمنصة على الإطلاق.

ar.howItWorks.step5Desc: كل دفعة في موعدها تبني نقاط موي الخاصة بك (0-1000). تتيح لك الدرجات الأعلى الانضمام لدوائر أكبر وشروط أفضل.

as.about.title: About Moistello
as.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
as.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
as.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
as.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
as.faq.title: FAQ
as.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
as.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
as.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
as.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
as.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
as.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
as.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
as.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
as.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
as.howItWorks.title: How It Works
as.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
as.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
as.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
as.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
as.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
as.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
as.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
as.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
as.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

as.support.commitmentRoadmapDesc: Feature requests are tracked publicly in our docs.

In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ay.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ay.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ay.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ay.faq.title: FAQ
ay.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ay.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ay.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ay.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ay.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ay.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ay.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ay.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ay.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ay.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ay.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ay.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ay.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ay.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ay.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ay.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ay.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ay.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ay.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

be.about.title: About Moistello
be.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
be.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
be.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
be.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
be.faq.title: FAQ
be.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
be.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
be.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
be.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
be.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
be.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
be.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
be.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
be.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
be.howItWorks.title: How It Works
be.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
be.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
be.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
be.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
be.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
be.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
be.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
be.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
be.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
bh.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
bh.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
bh.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
bh.faq.title: FAQ
bh.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
bh.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
bh.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
bh.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
bh.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
bh.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
bh.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
bh.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
bh.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
bh.howItWorks.title: How It Works
bh.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
bh.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
bh.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
bh.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
bh.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
bh.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
bh.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
bh.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
bh.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

bn.about.title: About Moistello
bn.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
bn.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
bn.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
bn.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
bn.faq.title: FAQ
bn.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
bn.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
bn.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
bn.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
bn.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
bn.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
bn.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
bn.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
bn.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
bn.howItWorks.title: How It Works
bn.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
bn.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
bn.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
bn.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
bn.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
bn.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
bn.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
bn.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
bn.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
br.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
br.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
br.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
br.faq.title: FAQ
br.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
br.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
br.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
br.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
br.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
br.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
br.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
br.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
br.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
br.howItWorks.title: How It Works
br.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
br.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
br.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
br.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
br.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
br.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
br.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
br.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
br.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ce.about.title: About Moistello
ce.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ce.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ce.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ce.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ce.faq.title: FAQ
ce.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ce.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ce.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ce.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ce.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ce.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ce.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ce.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ce.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ce.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ce.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ce.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ce.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ce.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ce.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ce.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ce.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ce.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ce.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
co.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
co.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
co.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
co.faq.title: FAQ
co.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
co.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
co.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
co.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
co.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
co.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
co.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
co.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
co.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
co.howItWorks.title: How It Works
co.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
co.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
co.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
co.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
co.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
co.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
co.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
co.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
co.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

cu.about.title: About Moistello
cu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
cu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
cu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
cu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
cu.faq.title: FAQ
cu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
cu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
cu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
cu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
cu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
cu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
cu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
cu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
cu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
cu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
cu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
cu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
cu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
cu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
cu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
cu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
cu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
cu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
cu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
cy.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
cy.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
cy.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
cy.faq.title: FAQ
cy.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
cy.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
cy.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
cy.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
cy.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
cy.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
cy.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
cy.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
cy.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
cy.howItWorks.title: How It Works
cy.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
cy.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
cy.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
cy.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
cy.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
cy.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
cy.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
cy.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
cy.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

dv.about.title: About Moistello
dv.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
dv.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
dv.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
dv.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
dv.faq.title: FAQ
dv.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
dv.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
dv.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
dv.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
dv.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
dv.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
dv.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
dv.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
dv.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
dv.howItWorks.title: How It Works
dv.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
dv.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
dv.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
dv.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
dv.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
dv.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
dv.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
dv.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
dv.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ee.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ee.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ee.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ee.faq.title: FAQ
ee.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ee.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ee.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ee.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ee.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ee.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ee.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ee.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ee.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ee.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ee.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ee.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ee.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ee.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ee.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ee.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ee.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ee.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ee.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

es.about.title: Acerca de Moistello
es.about.missionDesc: 1.300 millones de adultos siguen sin estar bancarizados a nivel mundial. En comunidades de África, América Latina, el sur de Asia y el sudeste asiático, las personas confían en círculos de ahorro informales — tandas, esusu, tontinas, chit funds — para acceder al capital y fortalecer su resiliencia financiera. Moistello envuelve este modelo centenario en contratos inteligentes Soroban en Stellar, brindando transparencia, seguridad y reputación portátil en la cadena a cada participante.
es.about.whyStellarDesc: Las tarifas de transacción inferiores a un centavo de Stellar y la liquidación en 3-5 segundos hacen que los ciclos de contribución sean prácticos. La plataforma de contratos inteligentes Soroban proporciona la programabilidad para reglas de pago complejas, mecánicas de subasta y seguimiento de reputación, manteniendo los costos de gas insignificantes.
es.about.openSourceDesc: Nuestros contratos inteligentes, API de backend y frontend son de código abierto bajo Apache 2.0. Contribuye en GitHub.
es.about.contactDesc: Únete a nuestro Discord o abre un problema en nuestro repositorio de GitHub.
es.faq.title: Preguntas Frecuentes
es.faq.a1: Una Asociación Rotativa de Ahorro y Crédito es un grupo que aporta una cantidad fija periódicamente. En cada ciclo, un miembro recibe el fondo total. Conocida en todo el mundo como tanda, esusu, tontina, chit fund y hui.
es.faq.a2: Los círculos tradicionales se basan en la confianza. Moistello utiliza autenticación basada en claves de acceso (passkeys) y contratos inteligentes Soroban para hacer cumplir las reglas de forma transparente. Sin correo electrónico, sin contraseña y sin cuenta bancaria. Inicia sesión con tus datos biométricos (Face ID, huella dactilar) y empieza a ahorrar.
es.faq.a3: No. Ni siquiera necesitas una billetera Stellar. Moistello crea una para ti automáticamente usando tu clave de acceso (Face ID o huella). Simplemente inicia sesión y comienza a ahorrar. Accesible para cualquier persona con un teléfono inteligente.
es.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). Más monedas estables en la hoja de ruta.
es.faq.a5: Los pagos atrasados incurren en una penalización configurable. Tras alcanzar el límite de faltas, el miembro es eliminado del círculo.
es.faq.a6: Tu reputación en la cadena (0-1000) construida a partir de rachas, círculos completados, volumen y frecuencia. Puntuaciones altas desbloquean círculos más grandes y mejores condiciones.
es.faq.a7: Completamente gratis para crear y unirse a círculos. Las tarifas de red de Stellar son inferiores a $0.001 por transacción. Cero comisiones de plataforma.
es.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Únete a nuestro Discord o abre una incidencia en GitHub.
es.howItWorks.title: Cómo Funciona
es.howItWorks.step1Desc: Usa Face ID, huella dactilar o PIN para crear tu cuenta. Sin correo, sin contraseña y sin configurar billetera.
es.howItWorks.step2Title: Crea o únete a un círculo
es.howItWorks.step2Desc: Establece el monto de contribución, frecuencia, número de miembros y tipo de pago. Tu billetera Stellar se crea automáticamente cuando te unes.
es.howItWorks.step3Desc: Tú y todos los miembros contribuyen con USDC o XLM en cada ciclo. Los contratos inteligentes registran cada pago en la cadena.
es.howItWorks.step4Desc: En cada ciclo, un miembro recibe el fondo completo. Orden: aleatorio, fijo, subasta o basado en votos.
es.howItWorks.step5Desc: Cada pago puntual aumenta tu MoiScore (0-1000). Puntuaciones más altas desbloquean círculos más grandes y mejores condiciones.
es.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: La función VRF del contrato inteligente selecciona el orden de pago. Justo e impredecible.
es.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: El organizador define el orden de pago por adelantado. Total transparencia.
es.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Los miembros pujan montos de descuento. Quien ofrece mayor descuento gana, y la diferencia se reparte entre todos.
es.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Los miembros votan en cada ronda quién recibe el pago. Próximamente.

et.about.title: About Moistello
et.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
et.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
et.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
et.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
et.faq.title: FAQ
et.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
et.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
et.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
et.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
et.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
et.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
et.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
et.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
et.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
et.howItWorks.title: How It Works
et.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
et.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
et.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
et.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
et.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
et.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
et.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
et.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
et.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

eu.about.title: About Moistello
eu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
eu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
eu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
eu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
eu.faq.title: FAQ
eu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
eu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
eu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
eu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
eu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
eu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
eu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
eu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
eu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
eu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
eu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
eu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
eu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
eu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
eu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
eu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
eu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
eu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
eu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ff.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ff.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ff.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ff.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ff.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ff.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ff.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ff.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ff.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ff.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ff.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ff.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ff.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ff.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ff.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ff.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ff.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ff.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ff.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

fo.about.title: About Moistello
fo.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
fo.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
fo.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
fo.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
fo.faq.title: FAQ
fo.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
fo.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
fo.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
fo.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
fo.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
fo.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
fo.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
fo.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
fo.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
fo.howItWorks.title: How It Works
fo.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
fo.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
fo.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
fo.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
fo.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
fo.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
fo.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
fo.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
fo.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

fr.about.title: À propos de Moistello
fr.about.missionDesc: 1,3 milliard d'adultes restent non bancarisés dans le monde. Dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, d'Asie du Sud et d'Asie du Sud-Est, les gens s'appuient sur des cercles d'épargne informels — tontines, esusu, chit funds, tandas — pour accéder au capital et renforcer leur résilience financière. Moistello intègre ce modèle séculaire dans des contrats intelligents Soroban sur Stellar, apportant transparence, sécurité et réputation transférable sur la blockchain à chaque participant.
fr.about.whyStellarDesc: Les frais de transaction minimes de Stellar et son règlement en 3 à 5 secondes rendent les cycles de cotisation pratiques. La plateforme de contrats intelligents Soroban offre la programmabilité nécessaire pour des règles de paiement complexes, des mécanismes d'enchères et le suivi de réputation — tout en maintenant des coûts de gaz négligeables.
fr.about.openSourceDesc: Nos contrats intelligents, notre API backend et notre frontend sont open source sous licence Apache 2.0. Contribuez sur GitHub.
fr.about.contactDesc: Rejoignez notre Discord ou ouvrez un ticket sur notre dépôt GitHub.
fr.faq.title: FAQ
fr.faq.a1: Une association rotative d'épargne et de crédit est un groupe de personnes qui cotisent régulièrement un montant fixe. À chaque cycle, un membre reçoit l'ensemble de la cagnotte. Connue dans le monde sous les noms de tontine, esusu, chit fund, tanda et hui.
fr.faq.a2: Les cercles traditionnels reposent sur la confiance. Moistello utilise une authentification par clé d'accès (passkey) et des contrats intelligents Soroban pour appliquer les règles de manière transparente. Aucun e-mail, mot de passe ou compte bancaire requis. Connectez-vous avec vos données biométriques (Face ID, empreinte) et commencez à épargner.
fr.faq.a3: Non. Vous n'avez même pas besoin d'un portefeuille Stellar. Moistello en crée un automatiquement pour vous grâce à votre clé d'accès (Face ID ou empreinte). Connectez-vous simplement et commencez à épargner. Accessible à toute personne possédant un smartphone.
fr.faq.q5: Que se passe-t-il si quelqu'un ne paie pas ?
fr.faq.a5: Les retards de paiement entraînent une pénalité configurable. Après le nombre maximal d'avertissements, le membre est exclu du cercle.
fr.faq.a6: Votre réputation on-chain (de 0 à 1000) calculée selon votre régularité, vos participations complétées, vos montants et la récence de vos activités. Des scores élevés débloquent des cercles plus importants et de meilleures opportunités.
fr.faq.a7: Entièrement gratuit pour créer et rejoindre des cercles. Les frais de réseau Stellar sont inférieurs à 0,001 $ par transaction. Aucuns frais de plateforme — point final.
fr.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Rejoignez notre Discord ou ouvrez un ticket sur GitHub.
fr.howItWorks.title: Comment ça marche
fr.howItWorks.step1Desc: Utilisez Face ID, votre empreinte ou un code PIN pour créer votre compte. Aucun e-mail, mot de passe ou configuration de portefeuille requis.
fr.howItWorks.step2Desc: Définissez le montant de la cotisation, la fréquence, le nombre de membres et le type de paiement. Votre portefeuille Stellar est créé automatiquement lors de votre inscription.
fr.howItWorks.step3Desc: Vous et tous les membres cotisez en USDC ou XLM à chaque cycle. Les contrats intelligents enregistrent chaque paiement sur la blockchain.
fr.howItWorks.step4Desc: À chaque cycle, un membre reçoit la totalité de la cagnotte. Ordre : aléatoire, fixe, enchères ou par vote.
fr.howItWorks.step5Desc: Chaque paiement ponctuel améliore votre MoiScore (0-1000). Des scores plus élevés débloquent des cercles plus importants et de meilleures conditions.
fr.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: La fonction aléatoire vérifiable (VRF) du contrat intelligent sélectionne l'ordre des versements. Équitable et impartial.
fr.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: L'organisateur définit l'ordre des versements à l'avance. Transparence totale.
fr.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Les membres proposent des remises. Le plus offrant en remise remporte la cagnotte, et le bénéfice est partagé entre tous.
fr.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Les membres votent à chaque tour pour désigner le bénéficiaire du versement. À venir prochainement.

fy.about.title: About Moistello
fy.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
fy.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
fy.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
fy.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
fy.faq.title: FAQ
fy.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
fy.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
fy.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
fy.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
fy.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
fy.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
fy.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
fy.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
fy.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
fy.howItWorks.title: How It Works
fy.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
fy.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
fy.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
fy.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
fy.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
fy.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
fy.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
fy.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
fy.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.
