gd.faq.title: FAQ
gd.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
gd.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
gd.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
gd.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
gd.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
gd.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
gd.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
gd.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
gd.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
gd.howItWorks.title: How It Works
gd.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
gd.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
gd.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
gd.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
gd.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
gd.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
gd.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
gd.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
gd.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

gu.about.title: About Moistello
gu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
gu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
gu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
gu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
gu.faq.title: FAQ
gu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
gu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
gu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
gu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
gu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
gu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
gu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
gu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
gu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
gu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
gu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
gu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
gu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
gu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
gu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
gu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
gu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
gu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
gu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ho.about.title: About Moistello
ho.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ho.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ho.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ho.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ho.faq.title: FAQ
ho.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ho.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ho.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ho.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ho.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ho.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ho.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ho.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ho.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ho.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ho.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ho.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ho.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ho.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ho.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ho.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ho.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ho.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ho.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

hz.about.title: About Moistello
hz.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
hz.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
hz.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
hz.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
hz.faq.title: FAQ
hz.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
hz.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
hz.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
hz.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
hz.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
hz.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
hz.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
hz.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
hz.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
hz.howItWorks.title: How It Works
hz.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
hz.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
hz.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
hz.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
hz.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
hz.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
hz.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
hz.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
hz.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

id.about.title: About Moistello
id.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
id.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
id.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
id.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
id.faq.title: FAQ
id.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
id.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
id.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
id.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
id.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
id.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
id.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
id.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
id.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
id.howItWorks.title: How It Works
id.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
id.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
id.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
id.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
id.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
id.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
id.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
id.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
id.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ii.about.title: About Moistello
ii.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ii.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ii.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ii.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ii.faq.title: FAQ
ii.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ii.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ii.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ii.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ii.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ii.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ii.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ii.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ii.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ii.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ii.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ii.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ii.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ii.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ii.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ii.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ii.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ii.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ii.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

io.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
io.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
io.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
io.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
io.faq.title: FAQ
io.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
io.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
io.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
io.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
io.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
io.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
io.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
io.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
io.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
io.howItWorks.title: How It Works
io.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
io.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
io.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
io.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
io.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
io.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
io.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
io.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
io.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

iu.about.title: About Moistello
iu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
iu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
iu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
iu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
iu.faq.title: FAQ
iu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
iu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
iu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
iu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
iu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
iu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
iu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
iu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
iu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
iu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
iu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
iu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
iu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
iu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
iu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
iu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
iu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
iu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
iu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

jv.about.title: About Moistello
jv.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
jv.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
jv.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
jv.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
jv.faq.title: FAQ
jv.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
jv.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
jv.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
jv.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
jv.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
jv.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
jv.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
jv.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
jv.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
jv.howItWorks.title: How It Works
jv.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
jv.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
jv.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
jv.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
jv.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
jv.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
jv.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
jv.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
jv.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ki.about.title: About Moistello
ki.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ki.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ki.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ki.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ki.faq.title: FAQ
ki.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ki.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ki.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ki.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ki.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ki.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ki.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ki.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ki.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ki.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ki.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ki.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ki.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ki.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ki.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ki.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ki.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ki.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ki.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

kk.about.title: About Moistello
kk.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
kk.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
kk.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
kk.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
kk.faq.title: FAQ
kk.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
kk.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
kk.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
kk.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
kk.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
kk.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
kk.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
kk.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
kk.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
kk.howItWorks.title: How It Works
kk.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
kk.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
kk.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
kk.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
kk.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
kk.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
kk.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
kk.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
kk.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

kn.about.title: About Moistello
kn.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
kn.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
kn.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
kn.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
kn.faq.title: FAQ
kn.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
kn.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
kn.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
kn.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
kn.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
kn.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
kn.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
kn.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
kn.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
kn.howItWorks.title: How It Works
kn.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
kn.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
kn.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
kn.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
kn.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
kn.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
kn.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
kn.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
kn.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
kr.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
kr.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
kr.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
kr.faq.title: FAQ
kr.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
kr.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
kr.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
kr.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
kr.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
kr.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
kr.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
kr.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
kr.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
kr.howItWorks.title: How It Works
kr.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
kr.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
kr.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
kr.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
kr.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
kr.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
kr.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
kr.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
kr.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

kv.about.title: About Moistello
kv.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
kv.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
kv.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
kv.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
kv.faq.title: FAQ
kv.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
kv.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
kv.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
kv.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
kv.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
kv.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
kv.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
kv.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
kv.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
kv.howItWorks.title: How It Works
kv.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
kv.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
kv.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
kv.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
kv.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
kv.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
kv.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
kv.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
kv.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ky.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ky.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ky.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ky.faq.title: FAQ
ky.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ky.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ky.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ky.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ky.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ky.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ky.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ky.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ky.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ky.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ky.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ky.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ky.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ky.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ky.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ky.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ky.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ky.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ky.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

lg.about.title: About Moistello
lg.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
lg.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
lg.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
lg.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
lg.faq.title: FAQ
lg.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
lg.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
lg.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
lg.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
lg.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
lg.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
lg.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
lg.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
lg.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
lg.howItWorks.title: How It Works
lg.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
lg.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
lg.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
lg.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
lg.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
lg.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
lg.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
lg.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
lg.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ln.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ln.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ln.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ln.faq.title: FAQ
ln.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ln.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ln.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ln.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ln.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ln.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ln.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ln.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ln.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ln.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ln.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ln.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ln.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ln.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ln.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ln.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ln.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ln.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ln.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

lu.about.title: About Moistello
lu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
lu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
lu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
lu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
lu.faq.title: FAQ
lu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
lu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
lu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
lu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
lu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
lu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
lu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
lu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
lu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
lu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
lu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
lu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
lu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
lu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
lu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
lu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
lu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
lu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
lu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
mg.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
mg.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
mg.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
mg.faq.title: FAQ
mg.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
mg.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
mg.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
mg.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
mg.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
mg.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
mg.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
mg.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
mg.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
mg.howItWorks.title: How It Works
mg.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
mg.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
mg.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
mg.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
mg.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
mg.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
mg.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
mg.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
mg.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

mk.about.title: About Moistello
mk.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
mk.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
mk.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
mk.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
mk.faq.title: FAQ
mk.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
mk.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
mk.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
mk.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
mk.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
mk.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
mk.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
mk.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
mk.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
mk.howItWorks.title: How It Works
mk.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
mk.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
mk.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
mk.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
mk.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
mk.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
mk.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
mk.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
mk.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
mn.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
mn.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
mn.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
mn.faq.title: FAQ
mn.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
mn.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
mn.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
mn.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
mn.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
mn.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
mn.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
mn.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
mn.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
mn.howItWorks.title: How It Works
mn.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
mn.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
mn.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
mn.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
mn.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
mn.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
mn.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
mn.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
mn.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

mt.about.title: About Moistello
mt.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
mt.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
mt.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
mt.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
mt.faq.title: FAQ
mt.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
mt.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
mt.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
mt.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
mt.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
mt.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
mt.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
mt.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
mt.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
mt.howItWorks.title: How It Works
mt.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
mt.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
mt.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
mt.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
mt.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
mt.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
mt.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
mt.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
mt.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
na.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
na.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
na.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
na.faq.title: FAQ
na.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
na.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
na.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
na.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
na.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
na.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
na.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
na.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
na.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
na.howItWorks.title: How It Works
na.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
na.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
na.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
na.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
na.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
na.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
na.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
na.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
na.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ne.about.title: About Moistello
ne.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ne.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ne.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ne.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ne.faq.title: FAQ
ne.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ne.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ne.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ne.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ne.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ne.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ne.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ne.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ne.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ne.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ne.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ne.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ne.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ne.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ne.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ne.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ne.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ne.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ne.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.
