Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
nl.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
nl.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
nl.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
nl.faq.title: FAQ
nl.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
nl.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
nl.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
nl.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
nl.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
nl.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
nl.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
nl.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
nl.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
nl.howItWorks.title: How It Works
nl.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
nl.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
nl.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
nl.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
nl.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
nl.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
nl.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
nl.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
nl.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

nr.about.title: About Moistello
nr.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
nr.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
nr.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
nr.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
nr.faq.title: FAQ
nr.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
nr.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
nr.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
nr.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
nr.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
nr.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
nr.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
nr.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
nr.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
nr.howItWorks.title: How It Works
nr.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
nr.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
nr.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
nr.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
nr.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
nr.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
nr.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
nr.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
nr.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ny.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ny.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ny.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ny.faq.title: FAQ
ny.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ny.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ny.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ny.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ny.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ny.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ny.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ny.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ny.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ny.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ny.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ny.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ny.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ny.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ny.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ny.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ny.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ny.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ny.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

om.about.title: About Moistello
om.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
om.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
om.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
om.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
om.faq.title: FAQ
om.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
om.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
om.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
om.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
om.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
om.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
om.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
om.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
om.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
om.howItWorks.title: How It Works
om.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
om.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
om.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
om.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
om.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
om.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
om.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
om.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
om.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
os.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
os.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
os.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
os.faq.title: FAQ
os.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
os.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
os.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
os.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
os.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
os.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
os.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
os.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
os.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
os.howItWorks.title: How It Works
os.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
os.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
os.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
os.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
os.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
os.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
os.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
os.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
os.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

pl.about.title: About Moistello
pl.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
pl.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
pl.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
pl.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
pl.faq.title: FAQ
pl.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
pl.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
pl.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
pl.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
pl.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
pl.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
pl.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
pl.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
pl.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
pl.howItWorks.title: How It Works
pl.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
pl.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
pl.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
pl.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
pl.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
pl.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
pl.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
pl.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
pl.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
pt.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
pt.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
pt.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
pt.faq.title: FAQ
pt.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
pt.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
pt.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
pt.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
pt.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
pt.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
pt.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
pt.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
pt.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
pt.howItWorks.title: How It Works
pt.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
pt.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
pt.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
pt.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
pt.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
pt.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
pt.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
pt.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
pt.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

rn.about.title: About Moistello
rn.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
rn.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
rn.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
rn.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
rn.faq.title: FAQ
rn.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
rn.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
rn.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
rn.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
rn.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
rn.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
rn.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
rn.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
rn.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
rn.howItWorks.title: How It Works
rn.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
rn.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
rn.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
rn.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
rn.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
rn.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
rn.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
rn.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
rn.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ru.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ru.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ru.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ru.faq.title: FAQ
ru.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ru.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ru.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ru.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ru.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ru.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ru.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ru.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ru.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ru.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ru.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ru.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ru.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ru.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ru.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ru.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ru.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ru.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ru.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

sc.about.title: About Moistello
sc.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
sc.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
sc.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
sc.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
sc.faq.title: FAQ
sc.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
sc.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
sc.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
sc.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
sc.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
sc.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
sc.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
sc.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
sc.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
sc.howItWorks.title: How It Works
sc.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
sc.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
sc.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
sc.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
sc.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
sc.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
sc.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
sc.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
sc.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
se.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
se.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
se.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
se.faq.title: FAQ
se.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
se.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
se.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
se.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
se.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
se.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
se.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
se.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
se.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
se.howItWorks.title: How It Works
se.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
se.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
se.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
se.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
se.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
se.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
se.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
se.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
se.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

sk.about.title: About Moistello
sk.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
sk.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
sk.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
sk.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
sk.faq.title: FAQ
sk.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
sk.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
sk.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
sk.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
sk.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
sk.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
sk.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
sk.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
sk.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
sk.howItWorks.title: How It Works
sk.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
sk.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
sk.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
sk.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
sk.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
sk.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
sk.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
sk.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
sk.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
sm.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
sm.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
sm.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
sm.faq.title: FAQ
sm.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
sm.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
sm.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
sm.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
sm.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
sm.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
sm.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
sm.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
sm.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
sm.howItWorks.title: How It Works
sm.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
sm.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
sm.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
sm.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
sm.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
sm.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
sm.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
sm.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
sm.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

sq.about.title: About Moistello
sq.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
sq.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
sq.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
sq.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
sq.faq.title: FAQ
sq.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
sq.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
sq.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
sq.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
sq.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
sq.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
sq.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
sq.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
sq.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
sq.howItWorks.title: How It Works
sq.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
sq.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
sq.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
sq.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
sq.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
sq.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
sq.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
sq.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
sq.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ss.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ss.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ss.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ss.faq.title: FAQ
ss.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ss.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ss.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ss.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ss.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ss.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ss.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ss.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ss.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ss.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ss.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ss.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ss.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ss.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ss.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ss.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ss.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ss.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ss.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

sv.about.title: About Moistello
sv.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
sv.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
sv.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
sv.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
sv.faq.title: FAQ
sv.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
sv.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
sv.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
sv.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
sv.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
sv.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
sv.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
sv.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
sv.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
sv.howItWorks.title: How It Works
sv.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
sv.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
sv.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
sv.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
sv.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
sv.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
sv.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
sv.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
sv.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ta.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ta.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ta.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ta.faq.title: FAQ
ta.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ta.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ta.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ta.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ta.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ta.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ta.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ta.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ta.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ta.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ta.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ta.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ta.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ta.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ta.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ta.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ta.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ta.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ta.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

th.about.title: About Moistello
th.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
th.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
th.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
th.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
th.faq.title: FAQ
th.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
th.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
th.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
th.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
th.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
th.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
th.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
th.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
th.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
th.howItWorks.title: How It Works
th.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
th.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
th.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
th.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
th.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
th.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
th.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
th.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
th.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
tk.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
tk.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
tk.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
tk.faq.title: FAQ
tk.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
tk.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
tk.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
tk.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
tk.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
tk.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
tk.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
tk.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
tk.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
tk.howItWorks.title: How It Works
tk.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
tk.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
tk.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
tk.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
tk.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
tk.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
tk.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
tk.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
tk.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

to.about.title: About Moistello
to.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
to.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
to.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
to.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
to.faq.title: FAQ
to.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
to.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
to.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
to.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
to.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
to.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
to.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
to.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
to.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
to.howItWorks.title: How It Works
to.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
to.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
to.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
to.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
to.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
to.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
to.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
to.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
to.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ts.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ts.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ts.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ts.faq.title: FAQ
ts.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ts.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ts.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ts.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ts.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ts.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ts.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ts.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ts.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ts.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ts.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ts.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ts.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ts.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ts.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ts.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ts.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ts.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ts.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ty.about.title: About Moistello
ty.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ty.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ty.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ty.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ty.faq.title: FAQ
ty.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ty.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ty.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ty.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ty.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ty.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ty.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ty.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ty.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ty.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ty.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ty.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ty.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ty.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ty.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ty.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ty.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ty.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ty.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
uk.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
uk.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
uk.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
uk.faq.title: FAQ
uk.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
uk.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
uk.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
uk.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
uk.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
uk.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
uk.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
uk.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
uk.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
uk.howItWorks.title: How It Works
uk.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
uk.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
uk.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
uk.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
uk.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
uk.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
uk.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
uk.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
uk.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

ve.about.title: About Moistello
ve.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
ve.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
ve.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
ve.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
ve.faq.title: FAQ
ve.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
ve.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
ve.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
ve.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
ve.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
ve.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
ve.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
ve.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
ve.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
ve.howItWorks.title: How It Works
ve.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
ve.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
ve.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
ve.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
ve.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
ve.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
ve.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
ve.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
ve.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
vo.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
vo.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
vo.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
vo.faq.title: FAQ
vo.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
vo.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
vo.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
vo.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
vo.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
vo.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
vo.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
vo.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
vo.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
vo.howItWorks.title: How It Works
vo.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
vo.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
vo.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
vo.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
vo.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
