vo.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
vo.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
vo.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

xh.about.title: About Moistello
xh.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
xh.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
xh.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
xh.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
xh.faq.title: FAQ
xh.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
xh.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
xh.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
xh.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
xh.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
xh.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
xh.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
xh.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
xh.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
xh.howItWorks.title: How It Works
xh.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
xh.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
xh.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
xh.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
xh.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
xh.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
xh.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
xh.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
xh.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

yo.about.title: About Moistello
yo.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
yo.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
yo.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
yo.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
yo.faq.title: FAQ
yo.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
yo.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
yo.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
yo.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
yo.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
yo.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
yo.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
yo.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
yo.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
yo.howItWorks.title: How It Works
yo.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
yo.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
yo.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
yo.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
yo.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
yo.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
yo.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
yo.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
yo.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.

zu.about.title: About Moistello
zu.about.missionDesc: 1.3 billion adults remain unbanked globally. In communities across Africa, Latin America, South Asia, and Southeast Asia, people rely on informal savings circles — esusu, tontines, chit funds, tandas — to access capital and build financial resilience. Moistello wraps this centuries-old model in Soroban smart contracts on Stellar, bringing transparency, security, and portable on-chain reputation to every participant.
zu.about.whyStellarDesc: Stellar's sub-cent transaction fees and 3-5 second settlement make contribution cycles practical. The Soroban smart contract platform provides the programmability for complex payout rules, auction mechanics, and reputation tracking — all while keeping gas costs negligible.
zu.about.openSourceDesc: Our smart contracts, backend API, and frontend are open source under Apache 2.0. Contribute on GitHub.
zu.about.contactDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
zu.faq.title: FAQ
zu.faq.a1: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group who contribute a fixed amount regularly. Each cycle, one member receives the total pool. Known worldwide as esusu, tontine, chit fund, tanda, and hui.
zu.faq.a2: Traditional circles rely on trust. Moistello uses passkey-based authentication and Soroban smart contracts to enforce rules transparently. No email, no password, no bank account needed. Sign in with your biometrics (Face ID, fingerprint) and start saving.
zu.faq.q3: Do I need a bank account?
zu.faq.a3: No. You don't even need a Stellar wallet. Moistello creates one for you automatically using your passkey (Face ID or fingerprint). Just sign in and start saving. Accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
zu.faq.a4: USDC (Stellar). More stablecoins on the roadmap.
zu.faq.a5: Late payments incur a configurable penalty. After max strikes, the member is removed from the circle.
zu.faq.a6: Your on-chain reputation (0-1000) built from streak, completions, volume, and recency. High scores unlock larger circles and better opportunities.
zu.faq.a7: Completely free to create and join circles. Stellar network fees are less than $0.001 per transaction. Zero platform fees — period.
zu.faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Join our Discord or open an issue on GitHub.
zu.howItWorks.title: How It Works
zu.howItWorks.step1Desc: Use Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN to create your account. No email, no password, no wallet setup needed.
zu.howItWorks.step2Desc: Set the contribution amount, frequency, member count, and payout type. Your Stellar wallet is created automatically when you join.
zu.howItWorks.step3Desc: You and all members contribute USDC or XLM each cycle. Smart contracts track every payment on-chain.
zu.howItWorks.step4Desc: Each cycle, one member gets the full pool. Order: random, fixed, auction, or vote-based.
zu.howItWorks.step5Desc: Every on-time payment builds your MoiScore (0-1000). Higher scores unlock larger circles and better terms.
zu.howItWorks.payoutRandomDesc: Smart contract VRF selects payout order. Fair and unpredictable.
zu.howItWorks.payoutFixedDesc: Organizer defines payout order upfront. Full transparency.
zu.howItWorks.payoutAuctionDesc: Members bid discount amounts. Lowest bidder wins, discount shared among all.
zu.howItWorks.payoutVoteDesc: Members vote each round on who receives payout. Coming in a future update.
